scale.rule: intelligence.value = 100 * (x - L) / (H - L), clamped to 0..100, where x is the ECI, or the LMArena rating mapped onto the ECI scale by a least-squares line fitted on the models that have both (coefficients in scale.lmarena_to_eci), and L, H are the lowest and highest ECI in the Epoch file. The raw value and the metric name stay in every row.

speed: not included: no lawful public per-model speed source exists. Iolite measures tokens per second locally from your own calls; nothing is uploaded.
